Title: General availability: Node.js SDK for Azure Mobile Apps 2.0.0

Body.Content:
Azure Mobile Apps 2.0.0 Node.js SDK is now generally available. A Yeoman generator (generator-azure-mobile-apps) that works with all Azure Mobile Apps clients was also released, which provides:
  • OData v3 interface for SQL Azure and on-premise SQL Server with offline-sync extensions
  • Custom API support
  • Azure App Service authentication and authorization support
  • Swagger and Swashbuckle support
  • TypeScript bindings
  • ES2015 support
For more information, see this post on npmjs.com: Azure Mobile Apps - Node SDK.
